# mtncloud_license

Master tenant only: customer (sub-tenant) logins get 403 from the API it uses. Manages the appliance license.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_license" "tf_example_license" {
  key = "22324FEF3WMCDMMSWE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String, Sensitive) The MTN Cloud license key

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the license

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import mtncloud_license.tf_example_license 1
```
